description: A React component for managing and editing restaurant delivery zones on Google Maps, including radius, polygon, and point zones, with address search and integration with GraphQL APIs.

classes.name: CustomGoogleMapsLocationBounds
classes.description: React functional component for selecting and updating restaurant delivery zones on Google Maps, supporting radius, polygon, and point zones with address autocomplete.

methods.name: updateCache
methods.description: Updates Apollo cache with new restaurant profile data after mutation.

methods.name: onErrorFetchRestaurantProfile
methods.description: Handles errors during fetching restaurant profile.

methods.name: onRestaurantProfileFetchCompleted
methods.description: Processes data after successfully fetching restaurant profile.

methods.name: onErrorFetchRestaurantZoneInfo
methods.description: Handles errors during fetching restaurant zone info.

methods.name: onRestaurantZoneInfoFetchCompleted
methods.description: Processes data after successfully fetching restaurant zone info.

methods.name: onErrorLocationZoneUpdate
methods.description: Handles errors during zone update mutation.

methods.name: onRestaurantZoneUpdateCompleted
methods.description: Handles successful zone update and updates map state.

methods.name: handleInputChange
methods.description: Updates address input value.

methods.name: onHandlerAutoCompleteSelectionChange
methods.description: Handles address selection from autocomplete, geocodes to get coordinates.

methods.name: onClickGoogleMaps
methods.description: Adds a point to the delivery zone path on map click.

methods.name: getPolygonPathFromCircle
methods.description: Generates polygon points approximating a circle for delivery zone.

methods.name: getPolygonPath
methods.description: Generates polygon points for a regular polygon zone.

methods.name: handleDistanceChange
methods.description: Updates delivery radius distance.

methods.name: locationCallback
methods.description: Updates map center and marker based on current location.

methods.name: onEdit
methods.description: Updates polygon path and center after editing polygon vertices.

methods.name: onLoadPolygon
methods.description: Sets up event listeners for polygon editing.

methods.name: onUnmount
methods.description: Removes polygon event listeners.

methods.name: removeMarker
methods.description: Removes the map marker.

methods.name: onDragEnd
methods.description: Updates marker and polygon when marker is dragged.

methods.name: onLocationSubmitHandler
methods.description: Saves the delivery zone configuration via GraphQL mutation.
